# Energy Transfer Phenomenon Note Catcher

Subject: Science
Grade band: 3-5
Resource type: Note Catcher
NYS framework label: New York State P-12 Science Learning Standards

## Short Description
A phenomenon-driven organizer for noticing, wondering, modeling, and revising energy transfer ideas.

## Alignment Note
Supports energy, modeling, evidence, and sensemaking practices.

## Classroom Use Case
Use with a short video or demonstration before students build explanatory models.

## Preview Content
- What do you notice?
- Where might energy be moving?
- Revise your model after discussion

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
